target_customer: B2B SaaS companies that want to deliver product demos or pull customer warehouse data into their app
problem: The YC launch post describes Fabra, a way for SaaS firms to sync data from customer data warehouses into their products. Other listings describe Demospace as voice AI product demos.

exit.reason: Not public. PitchBook lists the company as out of business.

technical_complexity.rationale: Connecting to warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift and Databricks is standard data engineering with many connectors.

defensibility.rationale: No evidence of data, customers or lock in.

market_need_then: No sourced evidence of customer demand at the time of founding was found, so the need for the product in early 2023 is unknown.

branding.domain_note: demospace.ai now redirects to a domain sale page on atom.com

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found, and the domain is now listed for sale.

pivots.why: Not sourced. Inferred only from conflicting listings, so treat as unverified.

outcome_analysis: Demospace was a two person Winter 2023 company that YC lists as inactive and PitchBook lists as out of business. No post-mortem or news about the shutdown was found, so the cause is not public, and the YC launch post and later listings describe different products.
notes: Bouncewatch and VCBacked report a $500K pre-seed in April 2023 with YC and Defy VC. These are unverified aggregator figures, not recorded as a round. Founding year is 2022 per YC and 2020 per another listing. The pivot entry is unverified. No dated competitor sources, so the list is empty.
